title: Topic 13: Travel & Transport - Speaking
description: Recorded speaking task, teacher-graded against a 4-criterion rubric.
canDoStatement: Name transport, buy tickets, handle simple travel situations

speakingTask.speakingPrompt:
Record yourself. Two mini parts:
PART 1 - Your transport: how do people in your family
go to work or school? (I go by... My mother goes by...)
PART 2 - Ticket office theater (two voices, like T11):
ask for a ticket to a real city, ask the time, ask the
price, say thank you.

Tip: by bus, by car - small words, no 'a', no 'the'!

teacherNotes: Source: tasilla_topic13_travel_transport.txt, Lesson 13.4. XP 15 on submit, +10 on approval.

criteria.title: Ticket request + time or price question
